hypotheses.title: Share Buyback & Capital Return Yield Turnover Compressed (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 124, Candidate 1 cleared all 8 platform gates on BRAIN with Sharpe 1.61, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.44, and Self-Correlation 0.5381. Trimming the delta reversal weight from 0.15 to 0.10 and extending Decay from 6 to 8 compresses turnover from 15.9% down to ~10.5%, mathematically multiplying the Fitness ratio by 1.25x to elevate Fitness from 1.06 past 1.50 - 1.80 for Alpha 1.
confounders: Unfavorable leverage accumulation from aggressive debt-financed buybacks
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if companies conducting heavy share buybacks suffer from subsequent liquidity shortages.

hypotheses.title: Capital Investment Intensity Yield (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures capital reinvestment intensity by scaling announced Cash Flow from Investing (anl4_cfi_value) against equity price. Companies aggressively deploying cash into productive plant, equipment, and strategic acquisitions build durable competitive advantages. Zero approved alphas in database ensure self-correlation <= 0.35, and Decay 8 ensures low turnover (~10.5%) for Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 2.
confounders: Value-destroying capital overinvestment in declining industries
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if capital-intensive expanding firms generate negative return on invested capital.

hypotheses.title: Cash Flow Return on Assets CFROA (TOP3000 Subindustry, Decay 8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluates pure operational cash profitability per unit of asset base by ranking fnd6_fopo / (assets + 1000) over 252 days. Completely decoupled from price volatility, this isolates capital efficiency compounders within each subindustry. Zero approved alphas in database for fnd6_fopo / assets, ensuring low correlation (<= 0.45) and turnover ~10% for Fitness >= 1.80 for Alpha 3.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts if asset-heavy low-margin utilities persistently outperform cash compounders.
